title.suggested: Tom Allen Offers to Buy Out Gallagher

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat printed Tom Allen's letter to a St. Louis friend after the Gallagher fiasco, offering to buy out Gallagher or any other champion for cash and to take terms at his saloon.

metadata.notes: masthead: Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, August 31, 1869

facts.fact: After the Gallagher draw, Allen wrote to a St. Louis friend offering to buy out Gallagher or any other champion
facts.quote: If Gallagher wishes to dispose of his place of business at a fair valuation, I am ready and willing to purchase the same and pay cash, and if any of the other champions wish to sell out, I have got the 'rhino' to put down and buy them out, bag and baggage.

facts.fact: Allen said challengers should leave the terms at his saloon
facts.quote: let them leave the terms at my saloon and they shall be promptly accommodated.

notes: Allen was writing from out of town (on tour in Kansas and Missouri at the time).
